releases.name: v2.0.9 — V1/V2 hybrid and Orca shared delegation
releases.body:
## 2.0.9 — fix: V1/V2 hybrid and Orca shared delegation (2026-09-04)

### Fixed
- **V1 host mis-dispatch fix**: Orca shared plugins on opencode 1.18.x with ctxKeys 9 now delegate to V1 DailyLogbookPlugin (isV1Host detection, Skipping v2)
- **Hybrid default restored**: Object.assign hybrid so V1 callable and V2 object checks both pass
- **Cache self-detection**: README Verify (9 places) + scripts/complete-uninstall.sh v5 (7 places) + verify-diagnostic-logs.ts

dist 32.35KB, bun test 85 pass

releases.name: v2.0.5 - make default object for V2 host
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **V2 host `Expected object`**: `2.0.4` hybrid was function with `id`/`setup`/`effect`, but `opencode2`'s `PluginModule` expects `default` to be `object` (`Expected object at ["default"]`) so `failed to load plugin`. Changed `export default` to `{id, setup: v2Setup, effect: v2Setup}` object for V2. `DailyLogbookPlugin` (V1 function) kept as named export.
- **Note**: `2.0.5` is `opencode2`-only. `opencode` 1.18.27 V1 will get `TypeError` for `2.0.5`, use `2.0.3` for V1.

## Verified

- `npx eslint .` 0, `npx tsc --noEmit` 0, `bun test` 85 pass, `dist 24.0KB`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smapira/opencode-autopilot-logbook/compare/v2.0.4...v2.0.5

releases.name: v2.0.4 - support both subscribe styles
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **V2 host E2E**: `v2Setup` only handled `subscribe({signal})=>AsyncIterable` (promise) so `opencode2 v0.0.0-beta-18999` with `subscribe("session.idle")=>Stream` (effect) stayed idle. Made `v2Setup` try both via `resolveV2Iterable`/`trySubscribeEffect`/`isAsyncIterable`/`runV2EventLoop` extracted to keep complexity <20.
- `tryCreateV2Plugin` now tries both `"@opencode-ai/plugin"` (`setup`) and `"@opencode-ai/plugin/effect"` (`effect`) defines, fallback is `{id, setup, effect}` so both hosts pass.
- Verified: mock effect and promise both PASS, `npx eslint .` 0, `npx tsc --noEmit` 0, `bun test` 85 pass, `dist 24.13KB`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smapira/opencode-autopilot-logbook/compare/v2.0.3...v2.0.4

releases.name: v2.0.3 - refactor complexity 20
releases.body:
## Changed

- **eslint 準拠リファクタ**: `eslint.config.mjs` を `globals` + `complexity:20` に更新。`daily-logbook.ts` の複雑度違反 3件 (`getUsageStats 29`, `event 27`, `handleV2IdleEvent 56`) を解消。`getUsageStats` をヘルパーに抽出、`event`/`handleV2IdleEvent` の重複 170行を `generateDailyLogbookCore` + `SessionAdapter` に集約し各関数を 20 以下に。
  - `package.json` に `globals@^17.12.0` 追加
  - `dist/index.js` 23.43 KB に再ビルド

## Verified

- `npx eslint .` 0
- `npx tsc --noEmit` 0
- `bun test` 85 pass
- `bun run build` 23.43 KB

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smapira/opencode-autopilot-logbook/compare/v2.0.2...v2.0.3
